description:
A Warhammer 40k faction mod

v0.1.5

v0.1.2 fixed yet another save-breaking bug that was still in v0.1.1. If you are using any version older than 0.1.2 update the mod ASAP

Requires:
LazyLib
MagicLib
GraphicsLib

Works with Nexerelin but doesn't require it.

GitHub

Features

The Imperium of Man, the Adeptus Mechanicus and the forces of Chaos as factions with their own ships and Nexerelin support

Imperium Ships (selection)

Mechanicus Ships

Chaos Ships (selection)

The Mercian system: home away from home to a stranded imperial fleet

Mercian Prime

Tons of new modular weapons as well as special semi-modular weapons

Semi-modular Weapons

(If you're a built-in weapon hater, don't worry this is mostly a gimmick of the Imperium/Mechanicus and, to a lesser extent, Chaos, upcoming factions will only use this system for torpedoes)

Embrace the corrupting influence of chaos, gain or lose favor with the chaos gods and reap special rewards

Touch of Chaos
Take on the mark of your god and become their champion, gaining a special skill

Summon hellish machines: unlock special weapons and wings based on your allegiance

Engrave your ships with the mark of your god, granting them powerful benefits for a downside and changing the appearance of chaos ships appropriately

(There's also lots of WIP Xenos content in the files that's not accessible in campaign yet if you want to have a look around)

WIP Xenos Shenanigans

Planned Features

More content for the existing factions

All missing major factions with their respective ship and weapon rosters (not playable just means you wont be able to get a commission from that faction)

Eldar (coming soon)
T'au Empire (coming soon)
Necrons (will probably behave similarly to the [Redacted], coming soon, not playable)
Drukhari
Tyranids (not playable, I'd like to make them an optional stellaris-style endgame crisis of sorts)
Adeptus Astartes
Orks (it will probably be a while, not playable)

Some questline or special progression gimmick for every playable faction

Exploration content with special rewards, including:

Rare and exotic weapons
At least one supercapital

I am also considering adding an optional boarding mechanic with accompanying boarding craft, boarding weapons etc.

Warning: This mod is still heavily WIP!

Most visuals are not final
There's a lot of content missing even for the factions that are already in
The balance is all over the place right now

Credits:

The portraits in this mod are slightly modified versions of portraits from Battlefleet Gothic: Armada 2 by Tindalos Interactive.
Some of the icons in this mod are modified screenshots from Battlefleet Gothic: Armada 2.
All portraits in this mod and the relevant icons are © Games Workshop Ltd.
Sections of the code for lances are modified versions of code from MagicLib. The relevant sections are marked as such and contain a copy of the MIT license for MagicLib, as required by that license.

AI Usage

The illustration for Chaos Summoning was generated by DALL.E 3 in Microsoft Designer and then manually tweaked.

Other Acknowledgments

Models from Battlefleet Gothic: Armada 2 were heavily used as references for ship sprites.
A big thank you to the starsector modding community and the many amazing tutorials and general resources without which this would not have been possible.
The original Battlefleet Gothic tabletop game and the Rogue Trader ttrpg were the main inspiration for this mod.
Special thanks to
Wispborne, for creating the amazing IntelliJ setup guide that eased my entry into starsector modding as well as for TriOS
All the contributors to MagicLib, which this mod makes heavy use of
Trylobot and Deathfly for creating and maintaining the Ship&Weapon Editor
RustyCabbage for creating SCVE, I dare not imagine how long all my testing and variant editing would have taken without it
The creators of Battlefleet Gothic Remastered which was my main reference on the lore and capabilities of different ship types
Alex, for creating the best spaceship game on the market (which has surprisingly many lore similarities to 40k)

Changelog
0.1.5
Compatible with earlier versions
- Fix compatibility with nexerelin 0.12
- Tweak nexerelin diplomacy traits and alignment of the Imperium

0.1.4
Compatible with older version
- Fix a crash when using chaos summoning before encountering the forces of chaos

0.1.3b
Compatible with earlier version
- Fix some game files accidentally being packaged in the jar (thanks to Dwarden for pointing this out)
- No functional differences to 0.1.3

0.1.3
Compatible with earlier version
- Make the Touch of Chaos event only show up once the player has had contact with the forces of chaos
- Change the visuals of Imperial and Mechanicus thrusters
- Add more ways to gain chaos favor (If anyone has a good Idea for nurgle please tell me)
- Change most lances to have a chance to pierce lighter targets
- Change lasburner visuals
- Add a comm relay, nav buoy and sensor beacon to the Mercian system (requires new game to take effect)

0.1.2
Compatible with earlier versions
- Fix another bug that could corrupt savegames

0.1.1
Compatible with 0.1.0
- Fix a bug that could corrupt savegames (big thanks to ultramite for bringing this to my attention and to Histidine for figuring out the problem)
- Reduce the frequency of chaos fleets haunting hyperspace

0.1.0
- Initial Release
- Add Imperium faction
- Add Mechanicus faction
- Add Chaos faction with subfactions for the gods
- Add ships, weapons, etc. for the Factions
- Add the Mercian System
- Add Touch of Chaos "event"

FAQ
Q: Help, my save is broken and I can't load it. What can I do?
A: If you are on any version older than 0.1.2 the most important thing is to update the mod. Unfortunately, any save that is already broken is likely unrecoverable even after the update but you should then be safe to continue from an earlier savegame.

Q: How do I gain chaos favor?
A: The main way to gain favor with a god is to defeat their enemies (the Imperium or their main rival among the other gods). Additionally, you gain favor with Khorne when defeating powerful fleets, with Tzeentch if you are the ruler of a powerful faction and with Slaanesh for buying drugs. Additional ways to gain favor will be added in the future. Feel free to tell me your ideas, especially for Nurgle.

discordPostHtml:
A Warhammer 40k faction mod.

Currently adds the Imperium of Man, the Adeptus Mechanicus and the Forces of Chaos.

Includes special semi-modular weapons and a mechanic for gaining favor with the Chaos Gods.

If you are using version 0.1.1 or older please update ASAP as 0.1.2 fixes a potentially save-breaking bug!

Changelog:

0.1.5 (Compatible with earlier versions)
- Fix compatibility with nexerelin 0.12
- Tweak nexerelin diplomacy traits and alignment of the Imperium

0.1.4 (Compatible with earlier versions)
- Fix a crash when using chaos summoning before encountering the forces of chaos

0.1.3b (Compatible with earlier versions)
- Fix some game files accidentally being packaged in the jar
- No functional differences to 0.1.3

0.1.3 (Compatible with earlier version)
- Make the Touch of Chaos event only show up once the player has had contact with the forces of chaos
- Change the visuals of Imperial and Mechanicus thrusters
- Add more ways to gain chaos favor (If anyone has a good Idea for nurgle please tell me)
- Change most lances to have a chance to pierce lighter targets
- Change lasburner visuals
- Add a comm relay, nav buoy and sensor beacon to the Mercian system (requires new game to take effect)


0.1.2 (Compatible with earlier versions)
- Fix another bug that could corrupt savegames

0.1.1 (Compatible with 0.1.0)
- Fix a bug that could corrupt savegames (big thanks to ultramite for bringing this to my attention and to Histidine for figuring out the problem)
- Reduce the frequency of chaos fleets haunting hyperspace

0.1.0
- Initial Release
- Add Imperium faction
- Add Mechanicus faction
- Add Chaos faction with subfactions for the gods
- Add ships, weapons, etc. for the Factions

- Add Touch of Chaos "event"

aiDescription: Adds the Imperium of Man, Adeptus Mechanicus, and Chaos as playable factions with unique ships and weapons. Introduces a modular weapon system and a 'Touch of Chaos' mechanic that allows players to gain favor with Chaos gods for special rewards. Includes the Mercian system as a starting location for stranded fleets.
